answer_1.quote: we formulate the ECE task as a template-based conditional generation problem, which takes the context and prompt template as the input, and decodes event causality and event structure from the generated sequence.
answer_1.outputs: event causality and event structure including event type and event arguments

answer_2.quote: We use precision (P), recall (R), and F1-score (F1) as evaluation metrics. A predicted cause-effect event pair is considered correct when the event type and event arguments of the cause event and effect event are correctly extracted.
